notes: An admin makes up a new password for someone who forgot theirs or never had one. It is shown only in this answer; the server keeps only its hash. username is optional for someone who has one (it stays, or changes to the one given) and needed for someone without one. The person's phones and browsers stay signed in, and their pauses after wrong passwords end. Not for oneself: 403 forbidden (Settings › Password, with the current one). Errors: 400 bad_request for a missing or unusable username (contract/usernames.json), 404 not_found, 409 username_taken.
